title: Installation Jobs: Window Series Frames and Crew Pace
content:
**Window series frames and crew pace — Installation Jobs**

The crew's daily pace on an **Installation Jobs** record is lowered by the frame of the window series the job installs, as the **Window Replacement Contracts** contract the job installs records its series:

| Window series of the contract the job installs | Daily pace lowered by |
|---|---|
| Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad | 2 openings a day |
| Ridgeline 5500 Series Fiberglass | 1 opening a day |
| Ridgeline 4400 Series Composite | 1 opening a day |
| a vinyl series (Ridgeline 1100 Series Vinyl, Ridgeline 2200 Series Vinyl, Ridgeline 3300 Series Premium Vinyl) | unchanged |
| a door job (no window series) | unchanged |

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

- A window job installing the Ridgeline 6600 Series Wood-Clad, at a daily pace of 5 openings before the series is considered, is paced at 3 openings a day.
- A window job installing the Ridgeline 4400 Series Composite at a daily pace of 4 openings before the series is considered is paced at 3 openings a day.
- A window job installing the Ridgeline 2200 Series Vinyl, or any door job, keeps its daily pace unchanged.
